description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS watchdog driver for Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040), implementing setup, disable, timeout installation, and feeding functionalities.

methods.name: wdt_rpi_pico_setup
methods.description: Initializes and configures the Raspberry Pi Pico watchdog hardware with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_rpi_pico_install_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout period for the watchdog.

methods.name: wdt_rpi_pico_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent reset.

methods.name: wdt_rpi_pico_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device at startup.
